function: End-to-end JEFPNet jointly learns pilot design, downlink channel estimation with CSI compression and DJSCC feedback at the UE, and user-adaptive Transformer precoding at the BS (p. 3)
system: FDD MU-MIMO-OFDM: BS with 32 antenna ports (8x8 dual-polarized array), single-antenna UEs, uplink 2.1 GHz, downlink 1.9 GHz, 96 subcarriers, 10 MHz; no RIS (p. 8)
method: Deep joint source-channel coding: convolutional encoder with trainable pilots at UE, Transformer precoder with user mask at BS; offline end-to-end training on a spectral-efficiency loss, no labels (pp. 5-8)
data_channel: QuaDRiGa 3GPP_38.901_UMa channels (17 clusters), 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 10,000 test samples; UMi dataset from QuaDRiGa for scenario shift (pp. 8, 14)
test_conditions: UMa training with random user mask (Kmax=6); tests with 2-6 users, SNR, pilot and feedback sweeps; UMa-to-UMi and UMi-to-UMa scenario shift (pp. 11-14)
baselines: SVD and MMSE precoding with water-filling after learned CE and feedback modules, SEFPNet (separately trained CE), JFPNet [17] under ideal CE, DFT pilot, DNN user-adaptive precoder [23] (pp. 9-11)
metrics: Downlink spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) against uplink, estimation and downlink SNR, users, pilot length, feedback size; parameters and FLOPs (pp. 6, 10-13)
complexity: Parameters and FLOPs per module (Fig. 13): at UE 2.63% of parameters and 0.019% of FLOPs of separate designs; 258,300 BS parameters (pp. 11-12)
q1_support: p. 8: "QuaDriGa [30], [31] is used to generate the corresponding uplink and downlink CSI" with the configuration "3GPP_38.901_UMa" and settings that "follow the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) TR 38.901 standard".
q2_support: p. 14: "under both UMa and UMi scenarios and subsequently test the trained models in both environments"; Table III reports the spectral efficiency of UMa-trained and UMi-trained models tested on both.
q3_support: p. 10: "delivers performance gains of 1.42 bps/Hz over SVD and 0.96 bps/Hz over MMSE" (non-learned precoders); p. 9: "we use the network architecture ideas as [17] to jointly design the CSI feedback and precoding design networks" (JFPNet, earlier learned method of the same authors).
q4_support: p. 12: "requires only 2.63% of the parameters and 0.019% of the FLOPs" compared with the separate architectures; Fig. 13 on p. 13 gives parameters and FLOPs per module.
q5_support: p. 8: "The dataset comprises 100,000 training samples, 30,000 validation samples" generated by the authors with QuaDRiGa; no code or data link, and no public channel dataset or measured data.
notes: Area: the work spans areas 2 and 3 (estimation, feedback and precoding); the main metric is the downlink spectral efficiency (Eq. 19, p. 6), so area 3 by the tie rule; the reviewer may confirm. q1: QuaDRiGa generator with the 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa model, also UMi in the shift test. q2: the scenario shift test is the only new-condition test counted; the orientation of Table III is ambiguous in the text. q3: SVD and MMSE with water-filling are non-learned precoders fed by separately trained CE and feedback networks; SEFPNet, De-Adaptive and DFT Pilot are variants of the proposed network and were not counted.
